metadata.title: Go-Ethereum (Geth) Execution Client Security Property Catalog
metadata.description: Comprehensive catalog of formal security properties with 100% coverage of all nodes and edges in the Program Graph. Each property defines invariants, transition security guarantees, and includes formal reachability analysis.

properties.property: STATE-EL-IDLE represents a secure quiescent state where the execution client awaits authenticated Engine API requests. No state modifications occur while in this state.
properties.anti_property: An attacker can trigger state modifications while the system is in STATE-EL-IDLE without going through ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-JWT.
properties.reachability_rationale: All paths leading to state modifications from STATE-EL-IDLE must traverse through ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-JWT. The graph structure enforces that any Engine API request (forkchoiceUpdated or newPayload) first passes through JWT validation before any state-affecting operations.
properties.notes: This is the system's ground state. Security depends on proper JWT validation implementation.

properties.property: STATE-CL-PREPARING-FORKCHOICE is exclusively reachable by the trusted ACTOR-CL-CONSENSUS-CLIENT. Only authenticated consensus clients can initiate fork choice updates.
properties.anti_property: An untrusted actor can reach STATE-CL-PREPARING-FORKCHOICE and initiate forkchoice updates.
properties.reachability_rationale: This state is associated with ACTOR-CL-CONSENSUS-CLIENT which has TRUSTED trust level. The Engine API requires JWT authentication which prevents untrusted actors from initiating requests that would reach this state.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: JWT authentication required for Engine API access
properties.notes: Trust assumption: CL client is correctly configured with shared JWT secret.

properties.property: STATE-CL-PREPARING-NEWPAYLOAD can only be reached by ACTOR-CL-CONSENSUS-CLIENT. Execution payloads for validation can only be submitted by authenticated consensus layer clients.
properties.anti_property: An untrusted actor can submit arbitrary execution payloads for validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: Only authenticated CL clients can call engine_newPayload. The JWT authentication requirement blocks untrusted actors from reaching this state.
properties.notes: While the CL is trusted, the payload content itself may originate from the network and requires full validation.

properties.property: ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-JWT is a mandatory checkpoint for all Engine API requests. All paths from CL states to EL processing actions must traverse this node.
properties.anti_property: A path exists that bypasses ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-JWT and reaches state-modifying actions directly.
properties.reachability_rationale: The graph structure explicitly requires all Engine API requests to pass through JWT validation. There are no alternative edges that bypass this action node.
properties.notes: Critical security control point. Implementation must reject expired tokens and validate signature correctly.

properties.property: STATE-EL-JWT-REJECTED is a terminal rejection state with no outgoing edges to processing states. Invalid JWT requests cannot proceed to any state-modifying operations.
properties.anti_property: A transition exists from STATE-EL-JWT-REJECTED to a state-modifying action.
properties.reachability_rationale: STATE-EL-JWT-REJECTED has no outgoing edges in the graph definition. It is a terminal state that prevents any further processing.
properties.notes: Proper error response should be returned without leaking timing information.

properties.property: ACTION-EL-PROCESS-FORKCHOICE is only reachable via successful JWT validation through EDGE-JWT-VALID-FORKCHOICE. Fork choice updates cannot be processed without prior authentication.
properties.anti_property: An unauthenticated request can trigger fork choice processing.
properties.reachability_rationale: The only incoming edge to ACTION-EL-PROCESS-FORKCHOICE is EDGE-JWT-VALID-FORKCHOICE, which originates from ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-JWT. No bypass path exists.
properties.notes: Source file: eth/catalyst/api.go:162-183

properties.property: ACTION-EL-CHECK-BLOCK-EXISTS verifies local chain state before accepting fork choice. The system cannot set a canonical head to a non-existent block.
properties.anti_property: The system accepts a fork choice pointing to a block hash that does not exist locally without entering SYNCING state.
properties.reachability_rationale: The action node has exactly two outgoing edges: EDGE-BLOCK-NOT-FOUND leads to STATE-EL-SYNCING, and EDGE-BLOCK-FOUND-SET-HEAD requires the block to exist. The graph structure prevents proceeding with a non-existent block.
properties.notes: This is a database lookup operation. Integrity depends on the local chain database.

properties.property: STATE-EL-SYNCING indicates the requested head block is not available locally. The execution client reports SYNCING status to the consensus layer, preventing invalid chain state.
properties.anti_property: The system returns VALID status when the head block does not exist locally.
properties.reachability_rationale: STATE-EL-SYNCING is only reached via EDGE-BLOCK-NOT-FOUND when a block lookup fails. The system correctly distinguishes between existing and missing blocks.
properties.notes: SYNCING response allows the CL to request the missing blocks via P2P sync.

properties.property: ACTION-EL-SET-CANONICAL-HEAD can only be reached after verifying the block exists via ACTION-EL-CHECK-BLOCK-EXISTS. The canonical chain head can only be set to a validated, locally-stored block.
properties.anti_property: The canonical head can be set to an arbitrary block hash without local verification.
properties.reachability_rationale: The only path to ACTION-EL-SET-CANONICAL-HEAD passes through ACTION-EL-CHECK-BLOCK-EXISTS with the block-found condition satisfied.
properties.notes: Chain reorganization security depends on this check.

properties.property: ACTION-EL-UPDATE-FINALIZED-SAFE updates finality pointers only after the canonical head has been successfully set. Finalized and safe block markers maintain consistency with the canonical chain.
properties.anti_property: Finalized/safe pointers can be updated independently of the canonical head, leading to inconsistent chain state.
properties.reachability_rationale: ACTION-EL-UPDATE-FINALIZED-SAFE is only reachable from ACTION-EL-SET-CANONICAL-HEAD via EDGE-HEAD-SET-UPDATE-FINALIZED. The ordering is strictly enforced.
properties.notes: Finalized blocks cannot be reverted. Safe blocks have high confidence of finality.

properties.property: ACTION-EL-START-PAYLOAD-BUILD is only triggered when PayloadAttributes are provided in the forkchoiceUpdated request. Block building only occurs when explicitly requested by an authenticated CL.
properties.anti_property: Block building can be triggered without proper authentication or without PayloadAttributes.
properties.reachability_rationale: ACTION-EL-START-PAYLOAD-BUILD is only reachable via EDGE-CHECK-PAYLOAD-ATTRS from ACTION-EL-UPDATE-FINALIZED-SAFE, which itself requires prior JWT authentication.
properties.notes: The ACTOR-MINER-BUILDER is an internal trusted component.

properties.property: STATE-EL-PAYLOAD-BUILDING represents active block assembly. Transactions are selected from the validated transaction pool and assembled into a block by the internal ACTOR-MINER-BUILDER.
properties.anti_property: Unvalidated transactions can be included in a block being built.
properties.reachability_rationale: Transactions entering STATE-EL-PAYLOAD-BUILDING must first pass through ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-TX and reach STATE-TX-PENDING. The graph enforces validation before inclusion.
properties.notes: Block builder uses validated transactions only.

properties.property: STATE-EL-FORKCHOICE-RESPONSE-READY contains the response to forkchoiceUpdated with accurate payload status. The response reflects the true state of block validation and optional payload ID.
properties.anti_property: A forged or inaccurate payload status is returned to the CL.
properties.reachability_rationale: This state is only reached after proper processing paths that correctly set the payload status based on actual validation results.
properties.notes: Response integrity is critical for consensus safety.

properties.property: ACTION-EL-PROCESS-NEWPAYLOAD is only reachable via successful JWT validation. Execution payloads can only be processed by authenticated consensus layer clients.
properties.anti_property: An unauthenticated entity can submit execution payloads for processing.
properties.reachability_rationale: The only incoming edge is EDGE-JWT-VALID-NEWPAYLOAD from ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-JWT. No bypass exists.
properties.notes: Source file: eth/catalyst/api.go

properties.property: ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-PAYLOAD-STRUCTURE performs structural validation on execution payloads before any state-affecting operations. Invalid payloads are rejected early.
properties.anti_property: Malformed payloads can bypass structural validation and trigger state modifications.
properties.reachability_rationale: All payloads must pass through structural validation. The two outgoing edges ensure either rejection or continuation based on validation result.
properties.notes: Validates: parent exists, timestamp ordering, block hash matches computed hash.

properties.property: STATE-EL-PAYLOAD-INVALID-STRUCTURE is a terminal rejection state for structurally invalid payloads. No state modifications occur for invalid payloads.
properties.anti_property: Structurally invalid payloads can proceed to execution.
properties.reachability_rationale: This is a terminal state with no outgoing edges to processing actions. Invalid payloads are definitively rejected.
properties.notes: INVALID_BLOCK_HASH status returned to CL.

properties.property: ACTION-EL-CONVERT-PAYLOAD-TO-BLOCK only processes structurally valid payloads. The conversion preserves data integrity from ExecutableData to Block representation.
properties.anti_property: Data corruption or manipulation can occur during payload-to-block conversion.
properties.reachability_rationale: This action is only reachable via EDGE-STRUCTURE-VALID after successful structural validation. The conversion is deterministic and preserves block hash integrity.
properties.notes: Block hash computed from converted data must match payload's declared hash.

properties.property: ACTION-EL-INSERT-BLOCK-WITHOUT-HEAD stores blocks without updating the canonical head. This preserves chain consistency during validation - blocks are stored but not finalized.
properties.anti_property: Block insertion automatically updates canonical head before full validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: The action explicitly does not set head. The canonical head is only updated through forkchoiceUpdated after successful validation.
properties.notes: Source file: core/blockchain.go. Non-canonical insertion prevents premature chain reorganization.

properties.property: ACTION-EL-PROCESS-BLOCK executes all transactions in the block through the state processor. Invalid transactions or state mismatches lead to block rejection.
properties.anti_property: Blocks with invalid transactions are marked as valid.
properties.reachability_rationale: Block processing has two outcomes: EDGE-BLOCK-VALID on success, EDGE-BLOCK-INVALID-EXEC on failure. The state processor validates every transaction and verifies the resulting state root.
properties.notes: Source file: core/state_processor.go:60-139. Delegates to GRAPH-BLOCK-PROCESSING sub-graph.

properties.property: STATE-EL-BLOCK-VALID is only reached when all transactions execute successfully AND the resulting state root matches the declared state root. Both conditions are mandatory.
properties.anti_property: A block is marked valid despite transaction failures or state root mismatch.
properties.reachability_rationale: EDGE-BLOCK-VALID is only traversed when ProcessResult indicates success. The state processor explicitly compares computed state root against declared state root.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: Merkle Patricia Trie state root verification
properties.notes: State root is the cryptographic commitment to all account balances, storage, and code.

properties.property: STATE-EL-BLOCK-INVALID correctly identifies and rejects blocks with transaction failures, state mismatches, or gas limit violations. Invalid blocks do not affect persistent state.
properties.anti_property: Invalid blocks corrupt persistent state before being rejected.
properties.reachability_rationale: Block processing uses transactional state. On failure, all changes are discarded. STATE-EL-BLOCK-INVALID leads to INVALID response without state commitment.
properties.notes: INVALID response includes latestValidHash for chain recovery.

properties.property: ACTION-EL-COMMIT-STATE is only reachable from STATE-EL-BLOCK-VALID. State changes are only persisted after complete block validation including state root verification.
properties.anti_property: Partial or invalid state changes are committed to persistent storage.
properties.reachability_rationale: The only incoming edge EDGE-VALID-COMMIT originates from STATE-EL-BLOCK-VALID. No path exists to commit state from any invalid state.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: Merkle Patricia Trie provides integrity verification
properties.notes: State commitment is atomic. Partial commits are not possible.

properties.property: STATE-EL-NEWPAYLOAD-RESPONSE-READY contains accurate payload status reflecting true validation result. VALID status is only returned for fully validated blocks.
properties.anti_property: VALID status is returned for blocks that failed validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: This state is reached via two distinct paths: EDGE-COMMIT-RESPOND from successful validation or EDGE-INVALID-RESPOND from failure. The payload status is set correctly on each path.
properties.notes: Response integrity is critical for consensus client decision making.

properties.property: ACTION-EL-GET-PAYLOAD requires valid payload ID from a prior forkchoiceUpdated call. Payload retrieval is authenticated via JWT and requires a legitimate build request.
properties.anti_property: Arbitrary payload IDs can be used to retrieve or forge payloads.
properties.reachability_rationale: ACTION-EL-GET-PAYLOAD is only reachable from STATE-EL-PAYLOAD-BUILDING via EDGE-CL-REQUESTS-PAYLOAD. The payload ID must correspond to an active build initiated by an authenticated request.
properties.notes: Payload IDs are opaque and must match active builds.

properties.property: STATE-EL-PAYLOAD-RETURNED contains a valid, internally-built execution payload. The payload contains only validated transactions and correct block headers.
properties.anti_property: A malformed or tampered payload is returned to the CL.
properties.reachability_rationale: Payloads are built internally by the trusted ACTOR-MINER-BUILDER using validated transactions. The payload construction process ensures correctness.
properties.notes: CL will propose this payload; network consensus will validate.

properties.property: STATE-USER-SUBMITTING-TX represents untrusted external input. All data from this state MUST be treated as potentially malicious and subject to comprehensive validation.
properties.anti_property: Transaction data from external users is trusted without validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: This is an entry point for untrusted data. The security property is not about reachability but about proper handling of untrusted input.
properties.notes: ACTOR-EXTERNAL-USER has UNTRUSTED trust level. Primary attack surface.

properties.property: ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-TX performs comprehensive transaction validation including signature verification, nonce check, balance sufficiency, gas limits, and format validation. All checks must pass for acceptance.
properties.anti_property: Invalid transactions can bypass validation and enter the transaction pool.
properties.reachability_rationale: The action has exactly two outcomes: EDGE-TX-VALID leading to STATE-TX-PENDING, or EDGE-TX-INVALID leading to STATE-TX-REJECTED. No path bypasses validation.
properties.notes: Validation includes: signature, nonce, balance >= gas * gasPrice + value, gas limit bounds, EIP-specific checks.

properties.property: STATE-TX-REJECTED is a terminal state for invalid transactions. Rejected transactions cannot enter the pool or be included in blocks.
properties.anti_property: Rejected transactions can somehow enter the transaction pool or be mined.
properties.reachability_rationale: STATE-TX-REJECTED has no outgoing edges to processing states. It is a terminal rejection state.
properties.notes: Error response returned to submitter without affecting system state.

properties.property: STATE-TX-PENDING only contains validated transactions. All transactions in the pending pool have passed signature verification and basic validation checks.
properties.anti_property: Unvalidated or invalid transactions exist in the pending pool.
properties.reachability_rationale: The only incoming edge is EDGE-TX-VALID from ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-TX. No path exists to add transactions to pending pool without validation.
properties.notes: Pending transactions await block inclusion. Re-validation occurs during block building.

properties.property: EDGE-CL-SENDS-FORKCHOICE requires JWT authentication. The DATA-JWT-TOKEN must be cryptographically verified before processing DATA-FORKCHOICE-STATE or DATA-PAYLOAD-ATTRIBUTES.
properties.anti_property: ForkchoiceUpdated requests can be processed without valid JWT authentication.
properties.reachability_rationale: This edge targets ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-JWT as its first destination. The JWT must be validated before any further processing can occur.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: HS256 JWT with shared secret between CL and EL
properties.notes: BOUNDARY EDGE: Trusted -> Trusted communication over network socket. JWT prevents unauthorized access.

properties.property: EDGE-CL-SENDS-NEWPAYLOAD requires JWT authentication. The DATA-EXECUTION-PAYLOAD must only be processed after JWT validation succeeds.
properties.anti_property: Execution payloads can be submitted and processed without authentication.
properties.reachability_rationale: This edge terminates at ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-JWT. No path exists to process payloads before authentication.
properties.notes: BOUNDARY EDGE: Although CL is trusted, payloads may originate from malicious validators. Full validation required.

properties.property: EDGE-JWT-VALID-FORKCHOICE is only traversed after successful JWT validation. The transition represents authenticated, authorized access to fork choice processing.
properties.anti_property: This edge can be traversed without successful JWT validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: This edge originates from ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-JWT with the condition that validation succeeded. Invalid tokens lead to EDGE-JWT-INVALID instead.
properties.notes: Condition: JWT token valid and not expired.

properties.property: EDGE-JWT-VALID-NEWPAYLOAD is only traversed after successful JWT validation. Only authenticated requests can reach payload processing.
properties.anti_property: Payload processing can begin without JWT authentication.
properties.reachability_rationale: This edge requires successful JWT validation. The graph structure ensures authentication precedes processing.
properties.notes: Condition: JWT token valid and not expired.

properties.property: EDGE-JWT-INVALID leads to a terminal rejection state. Invalid or missing JWT tokens result in immediate request rejection with no further processing.
properties.anti_property: Invalid JWT tokens do not prevent further processing.
properties.reachability_rationale: This edge is the security enforcement path. It ensures invalid tokens lead to definitive rejection.
properties.notes: HTTP 401 Unauthorized response returned.

properties.property: EDGE-FORKCHOICE-CHECK-BLOCK transfers DATA-FORKCHOICE-STATE to block existence verification. The fork choice head hash is verified against local chain before acceptance.
properties.anti_property: Fork choice can be accepted without verifying the head block exists.
properties.reachability_rationale: This edge is mandatory in the fork choice processing path. Block existence verification is a required step.
properties.notes: Integrity of local chain database is assumed.

properties.property: EDGE-BLOCK-NOT-FOUND correctly routes to SYNCING state when the head block is not locally available. The system correctly reports its sync status.
properties.anti_property: Missing blocks are not detected, leading to incorrect chain state.
properties.reachability_rationale: This is a correct behavior path for handling missing blocks. It enables proper sync coordination with CL.
properties.notes: SYNCING response allows CL to initiate block sync.

properties.property: EDGE-BLOCK-FOUND-SET-HEAD only traverses when the block exists locally. The canonical head is only set to verified, locally-present blocks.
properties.anti_property: Canonical head can be set to blocks that don't exist locally.
properties.reachability_rationale: This edge is only traversed when block lookup succeeds. The condition is explicitly verified by ACTION-EL-CHECK-BLOCK-EXISTS.
properties.notes: DATA-BLOCK is retrieved from local database, not from the request.

properties.property: EDGE-HEAD-SET-UPDATE-FINALIZED ensures proper sequencing: finalized/safe pointers are only updated after canonical head is set. Chain state remains consistent.
properties.anti_property: Finalized/safe pointers can be updated before canonical head, causing inconsistency.
properties.reachability_rationale: The graph structure enforces this ordering. ACTION-EL-UPDATE-FINALIZED-SAFE only has incoming edge from ACTION-EL-SET-CANONICAL-HEAD.
properties.notes: Finalized blocks are irreversible. Consistency is critical.

properties.property: EDGE-CHECK-PAYLOAD-ATTRS only traverses when PayloadAttributes are provided. Block building is explicitly requested, not automatic.
properties.anti_property: Block building starts without explicit PayloadAttributes in the request.
properties.reachability_rationale: The edge condition requires PayloadAttributes to be present. Without them, EDGE-NO-PAYLOAD-ATTRS is taken instead.
properties.notes: PayloadAttributes include timestamp, prevRandao, feeRecipient.

properties.property: EDGE-NO-PAYLOAD-ATTRS correctly handles forkchoiceUpdated without PayloadAttributes. No block building occurs and response is returned immediately.
properties.anti_property: Block building is triggered even when PayloadAttributes are not provided.
properties.reachability_rationale: This is the correct path when no block building is requested. The edge condition is the absence of PayloadAttributes.
properties.notes: ForkchoiceUpdated can be called purely for chain head updates without block building.

properties.property: EDGE-PAYLOAD-BUILD-STARTED initiates block assembly using only validated transactions from the pool. DATA-TRANSACTION references are to pre-validated pending transactions.
properties.anti_property: Unvalidated transactions can be selected for block building.
properties.reachability_rationale: Transactions for block building come from STATE-TX-PENDING, which only contains validated transactions. The pool maintains this invariant.
properties.notes: Block builder selects from validated pending pool.

properties.property: EDGE-PAYLOAD-BUILD-RESPONSE returns a valid PayloadID to the CL. The ID uniquely identifies the ongoing build and is required for payload retrieval.
properties.anti_property: Invalid or reusable PayloadIDs are returned, enabling payload confusion attacks.
properties.reachability_rationale: PayloadIDs are generated internally and uniquely identify build sessions. The response correctly includes the new ID.
properties.notes: PayloadID format: unique identifier for the build request.

properties.property: EDGE-FORKCHOICE-COMPLETE returns DATA-PAYLOAD-STATUS accurately reflecting the validation result. The response content matches the actual chain state.
properties.anti_property: Payload status response is forged or inaccurate.
properties.reachability_rationale: The response is constructed from actual processing results. No path allows falsifying the status.
properties.notes: Response integrity ensures correct CL decision-making.

properties.property: EDGE-NEWPAYLOAD-VALIDATE-STRUCTURE ensures all payloads undergo structural validation before any execution. DATA-EXECUTION-PAYLOAD is validated for integrity before processing.
properties.anti_property: Malformed payloads can bypass structural validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: This is the only outgoing edge from ACTION-EL-PROCESS-NEWPAYLOAD. All payloads must traverse it.
properties.notes: First line of defense against malformed payloads.

properties.property: EDGE-STRUCTURE-INVALID routes structurally invalid payloads to rejection. Invalid payloads cannot proceed to execution.
properties.anti_property: Structurally invalid payloads can proceed to transaction execution.
properties.reachability_rationale: This is the error handling path for invalid payload structure. It correctly prevents further processing.
properties.notes: INVALID_BLOCK_HASH or similar error returned.

properties.property: EDGE-STRUCTURE-VALID only traverses after all structural checks pass. DATA-EXECUTION-PAYLOAD has been verified for basic integrity.
properties.anti_property: This edge can be traversed for payloads that fail structural validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: The edge condition requires successful structural validation. Invalid payloads take EDGE-STRUCTURE-INVALID instead.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: Block hash verified to match payload contents
properties.notes: Parent existence, timestamp ordering, and hash integrity verified.

properties.property: EDGE-CONVERT-INSERT transfers DATA-BLOCK after conversion from payload. The block representation maintains integrity with the original payload.
properties.anti_property: Data integrity is lost during payload-to-block conversion.
properties.reachability_rationale: Conversion is deterministic. Block hash computed from converted data must match the pre-validated payload hash.
properties.notes: Lossless conversion from ExecutableData to Block.

properties.property: EDGE-INSERT-PROCESS ensures blocks are stored before processing. DATA-BLOCK is persistently stored (without setting head) before transaction execution.
properties.anti_property: Blocks are processed without being stored, leading to data loss on failure.
properties.reachability_rationale: Block insertion precedes processing. This ordering is enforced by the graph structure.
properties.notes: Non-canonical insertion preserves the block for potential future use.

properties.property: EDGE-BLOCK-VALID only traverses when all transactions execute successfully AND the final state root matches. DATA-PROCESS-RESULT contains successful validation outcome.
properties.anti_property: EDGE-BLOCK-VALID can be traversed despite transaction failures or state mismatch.
properties.reachability_rationale: State processor explicitly compares computed state root with declared root. Any mismatch routes to EDGE-BLOCK-INVALID-EXEC.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: Merkle Patricia Trie state root verification
properties.notes: Complete block validation success.

properties.property: EDGE-BLOCK-INVALID-EXEC correctly routes blocks with transaction failures or state mismatches to rejection. All state changes are rolled back.
properties.anti_property: Failed block processing doesn't properly route to rejection state.
properties.reachability_rationale: This is the error handling path. Block processing uses transactional state that is discarded on this path.
properties.notes: State rollback ensures no partial corruption.

properties.property: EDGE-VALID-COMMIT only occurs after complete block validation. DATA-STATE-OBJECT changes are only committed to persistent storage for fully validated blocks.
properties.anti_property: State changes from invalid blocks are committed to persistent storage.
properties.reachability_rationale: EDGE-VALID-COMMIT originates from STATE-EL-BLOCK-VALID, which is only reached after successful validation. No path from invalid states leads to commit.
properties.notes: BOUNDARY EDGE (internal): State commitment is atomic and verified.

properties.property: EDGE-COMMIT-RESPOND follows state commitment with VALID status response. DATA-PAYLOAD-STATUS accurately reflects successful validation.
properties.anti_property: INVALID status is returned for successfully validated and committed blocks.
properties.reachability_rationale: This path is only reached after successful commit. The response status is set to VALID on this path.
properties.notes: Response latestValidHash set to the validated block hash.

properties.property: EDGE-INVALID-RESPOND correctly reports INVALID status for blocks that failed validation. DATA-PAYLOAD-STATUS includes latestValidHash for chain recovery.
properties.anti_property: VALID status is returned for invalid blocks.
properties.reachability_rationale: This path originates from STATE-EL-BLOCK-INVALID. The response status is set to INVALID on this path.
properties.notes: latestValidHash helps CL identify the fork point.

properties.property: EDGE-NEWPAYLOAD-COMPLETE returns accurate DATA-PAYLOAD-STATUS to the consensus layer. The response enables correct fork choice decisions.
properties.anti_property: Inaccurate payload status is returned, leading to consensus errors.
properties.reachability_rationale: Response is constructed from actual validation results through the processing pipeline.
properties.notes: Consensus safety depends on accurate EL responses.

properties.property: EDGE-CL-REQUESTS-PAYLOAD requires JWT authentication and valid PayloadID. Only the CL that initiated the build can retrieve the payload.
properties.anti_property: Payloads can be retrieved without authentication or with arbitrary PayloadIDs.
properties.reachability_rationale: getPayload RPC also requires JWT authentication. The PayloadID must match an active build from a prior authenticated request.
properties.notes: BOUNDARY EDGE: CL -> EL request for built payload.

properties.property: EDGE-PAYLOAD-RETRIEVED returns DATA-EXECUTION-PAYLOAD and DATA-BLOB-SIDECAR built by the internal trusted block builder. The payload is valid and ready for proposal.
properties.anti_property: Invalid or tampered payloads are returned to the CL.
properties.reachability_rationale: Payloads are constructed internally using validated transactions. The ACTOR-MINER-BUILDER is a trusted internal component.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: Block hash integrity, blob KZG commitments (Cancun+)
properties.notes: BOUNDARY EDGE: EL -> CL response with built payload.

properties.property: EDGE-PAYLOAD-RETURNED-IDLE returns the system to idle state after payload delivery. The build session is complete.
properties.anti_property: System remains in payload building state after delivery, causing resource exhaustion.
properties.reachability_rationale: Normal completion path for payload delivery. Resources are released when returning to idle.
properties.notes: Clean state transition after successful payload delivery.

properties.property: EDGE-USER-SUBMIT-TX transfers untrusted DATA-TRANSACTION from external user to validation. All transaction data is treated as potentially malicious.
properties.anti_property: User-submitted transactions are trusted without validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: This is the primary attack surface. The edge leads directly to validation action, not to any trusted processing.
properties.notes: BOUNDARY EDGE (CRITICAL): UNTRUSTED -> TRUSTED. Comprehensive validation mandatory.

properties.property: EDGE-TX-VALID only traverses after all validation checks pass. DATA-TRANSACTION signature, nonce, balance, gas, and format have been verified.
properties.anti_property: Invalid transactions can traverse this edge and enter the pending pool.
properties.reachability_rationale: ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-TX performs comprehensive validation. Only passing transactions take this edge; failures take EDGE-TX-INVALID.
properties.notes: Validation includes: signature recovery, nonce check, balance >= cost, gas bounds, format rules.

properties.property: EDGE-TX-INVALID routes all failing transactions to rejection. Invalid transactions cannot enter the pending pool.
properties.anti_property: Some invalid transactions bypass this edge and enter the pool.
properties.reachability_rationale: This is the error handling path for transaction validation. All validation failures lead here.
properties.notes: Error returned to submitter without affecting system state.

properties.property: EDGE-TX-INCLUDED selects validated pending transactions for block inclusion. DATA-TRANSACTION selected for building has been pre-validated.
properties.anti_property: Unvalidated transactions can be selected for block inclusion.
properties.reachability_rationale: STATE-TX-PENDING only contains validated transactions. The pool invariant ensures all included transactions have passed validation.
properties.notes: BOUNDARY EDGE: Transaction from pool (originally untrusted source) to block builder.

properties.property: STATE-BLOCK-RECEIVED represents a block ready for processing. The block has passed prior structural validation and is now subject to transaction execution.
properties.anti_property: Blocks in this state have not been structurally validated.
properties.reachability_rationale: This sub-graph is entered from ACTION-EL-PROCESS-BLOCK which requires prior structural validation in the main graph.
properties.notes: Entry point for block processing sub-graph.

properties.property: ACTION-INIT-PROCESSING correctly initializes receipts array, gas pool, and EVM context. Proper initialization ensures isolation between block processing sessions.
properties.anti_property: Block processing uses uninitialized or stale context from previous blocks.
properties.reachability_rationale: Initialization is the first mandatory step. Fresh context is created for each block.
properties.notes: Gas pool initialized to block gas limit.

properties.property: ACTION-APPLY-HARD-FORKS applies fork-specific state mutations before transaction processing. Fork rules are applied consistently based on block number/timestamp.
properties.anti_property: Fork-specific state changes are not applied or applied inconsistently.
properties.reachability_rationale: Fork application is deterministic based on block height. Chain configuration determines which forks apply.
properties.notes: Examples: DAO fork irregular state change, difficulty bomb adjustments.

properties.property: ACTION-PROCESS-BEACON-ROOT (EIP-4788) correctly stores beacon block root before transaction processing. The root is available for cross-layer verification.
properties.anti_property: Beacon root is not stored or stored incorrectly, breaking cross-layer proofs.
properties.reachability_rationale: System call to beacon roots contract is mandatory for Cancun+ blocks. Executed before any user transactions.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: Beacon root is the Merkle root from consensus layer
properties.notes: EIP-4788: Enables trustless cross-layer communication.

properties.property: ACTION-PROCESS-PARENT-HASH (EIP-2935) correctly stores parent block hash for historical access. Ring buffer provides 8191 blocks of history.
properties.anti_property: Parent hash storage fails, breaking BLOCKHASH opcode for recent blocks.
properties.reachability_rationale: System call to history contract is mandatory for Prague+ blocks. Executed before user transactions.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: Block hash is cryptographic commitment to block contents
properties.notes: EIP-2935: Extends BLOCKHASH beyond 256 blocks.

properties.property: STATE-ITERATING-TXS represents the transaction processing loop. Each transaction is processed in order with proper isolation between executions.
properties.anti_property: Transactions are processed out of order or without proper isolation.
properties.reachability_rationale: Transaction ordering follows block transaction list. Each transaction gets a fresh EVM context while sharing state database.
properties.notes: Deterministic ordering ensures consensus across all nodes.

properties.property: ACTION-TX-TO-MESSAGE correctly decodes transaction into Message format. Effective gas price is computed based on transaction type and block base fee.
properties.anti_property: Transaction decoding produces incorrect Message, affecting execution.
properties.reachability_rationale: TransactionToMessage is a deterministic conversion. Signature recovery determines sender address.
properties.notes: EIP-1559: effectiveGasPrice = min(baseFee + tip, maxFee)

properties.property: ACTION-SET-TX-CONTEXT correctly sets transaction hash and index in state database. This enables proper log attribution and receipt generation.
properties.anti_property: Incorrect transaction context leads to wrong log/receipt attribution.
properties.reachability_rationale: SetTxContext is a simple state update. Transaction index follows iteration order.
properties.notes: Logs are indexed by transaction hash.

properties.property: ACTION-APPLY-TX-WITH-EVM executes transaction through the state transition function. Gas metering and state changes are applied atomically.
properties.anti_property: Transaction execution corrupts state or fails to properly meter gas.
properties.reachability_rationale: State transition function is the core execution engine. Delegates to GRAPH-STATE-TRANSITION for detailed execution.
properties.notes: Each transaction execution is atomic.

properties.property: STATE-TX-EXECUTED represents successful transaction execution. Gas has been properly deducted and state changes applied.
properties.anti_property: This state is reached without proper execution completing.
properties.reachability_rationale: Only reached via EDGE-BP-EXECUTED from completed transaction execution.
properties.notes: Execution result contains gas used and return data.

properties.property: ACTION-COLLECT-RECEIPT correctly generates and stores transaction receipt. Receipt includes status, gas used, and logs.
properties.anti_property: Receipt generation fails or produces incorrect data.
properties.reachability_rationale: Receipt is deterministically generated from execution result. Cumulative gas is correctly tracked.
properties.notes: Receipt root in block header commits to all receipts.

properties.property: STATE-ALL-TXS-PROCESSED indicates all block transactions have been executed. Ready for post-transaction system calls and finalization.
properties.anti_property: This state is reached before all transactions are processed.
properties.reachability_rationale: Only reached via EDGE-BP-ALL-DONE when transaction iterator is exhausted.
properties.notes: Transition from iteration loop to finalization phase.

properties.property: ACTION-PROCESS-REQUESTS-PRAGUE executes EIP-6110/7002/7251 system calls. Deposit, withdrawal, and consolidation requests are processed after user transactions.
properties.anti_property: System calls fail to execute or produce incorrect requests.
properties.reachability_rationale: System calls are mandatory for Prague+ blocks. Each contract is called with SYSTEM_ADDRESS as caller.
properties.notes: Requests are included in block header commitment (requests_hash).

properties.property: ACTION-FINALIZE-BLOCK applies consensus engine finalization. Block rewards (if any) and uncle rewards are applied to coinbase.
properties.anti_property: Finalization fails to apply correct rewards or applies incorrect amounts.
properties.reachability_rationale: Finalization is deterministic based on consensus rules. Post-merge: no block rewards (validators rewarded on beacon chain).
properties.notes: Final step before state root computation.

properties.property: STATE-PROCESS-COMPLETE indicates successful block processing. DATA-PROCESS-RESULT contains receipts, requests, logs, and total gas used.
properties.anti_property: Processing completes with inconsistent or incomplete results.
properties.reachability_rationale: Only reached after successful processing of all transactions and system calls. Return point to main graph.
properties.notes: State root can now be computed and compared with block header.

properties.property: EDGE-BP-INIT transfers DATA-BLOCK to initialization. Block header data used to configure processing context.
properties.anti_property: Block processing starts without proper initialization.
properties.reachability_rationale: Entry edge to block processing. Initialization is mandatory first step.
properties.notes: Block number, timestamp, coinbase used in context.

properties.property: EDGE-BP-FORKS ensures fork mutations are applied in correct order after initialization.
properties.anti_property: Fork mutations applied before initialization or in wrong order.
properties.reachability_rationale: Sequential edge enforcing initialization -> fork application order.
properties.notes: Order: init -> forks -> beacon root -> parent hash -> transactions.

properties.property: EDGE-BP-BEACON ensures beacon root processing (EIP-4788) occurs after fork mutations but before user transactions.
properties.anti_property: Beacon root processed at wrong point, affecting contract visibility.
properties.reachability_rationale: Ordering ensures beacon root is available before any user contract execution.
properties.notes: Cancun+ only. System call with SYSTEM_ADDRESS.

properties.property: EDGE-BP-PARENT ensures parent hash storage (EIP-2935) occurs before user transactions.
properties.anti_property: Parent hash stored after transactions, making it unavailable to contracts.
properties.reachability_rationale: Ordering ensures BLOCKHASH extended history is available during execution.
properties.notes: Prague+ only. System call with SYSTEM_ADDRESS.

properties.property: EDGE-BP-ITERATE begins transaction iteration after all pre-transaction setup is complete.
properties.anti_property: Transaction iteration begins before pre-transaction setup completes.
properties.reachability_rationale: System calls complete before user transactions start.
properties.notes: All pre-transaction state mutations visible to first user transaction.

properties.property: EDGE-BP-CONVERT transfers DATA-TRANSACTION for Message conversion in iteration order.
properties.anti_property: Transactions processed out of block order.
properties.reachability_rationale: Iterator processes transactions in block transaction list order.
properties.notes: Transaction order affects state and must be deterministic.

properties.property: EDGE-BP-CONTEXT transfers DATA-MESSAGE with sender and gas price computed from signature and EIP-1559 rules.
properties.anti_property: Incorrect sender or gas price used for execution.
properties.reachability_rationale: Message conversion is deterministic. Sender derived from signature.
properties.notes: EIP-1559 effectiveGasPrice calculation.

properties.property: EDGE-BP-APPLY transfers DATA-MESSAGE and DATA-EVM-CONTEXT to EVM for execution. Message contains potentially untrusted user data.
properties.anti_property: EVM receives incorrect context or corrupted message data.
properties.reachability_rationale: Context correctly set before EVM invocation. Message data originates from signed transaction.
properties.notes: BOUNDARY EDGE: User data (calldata) flows into EVM. EVM sandbox contains execution.

properties.property: EDGE-BP-EXECUTED transfers DATA-EXECUTION-RESULT with accurate gas usage and execution outcome.
properties.anti_property: Execution result contains incorrect gas accounting or status.
properties.reachability_rationale: Execution result is computed by state transition function. Gas accounting is deterministic.
properties.notes: Result used for receipt generation and cumulative gas.

properties.property: EDGE-BP-RECEIPT transfers DATA-RECEIPT for collection. Receipt correctly captures execution outcome.
properties.anti_property: Receipt doesn't accurately reflect transaction execution.
properties.reachability_rationale: Receipt generation is deterministic from execution result.
properties.notes: Receipts root in block header provides commitment.

properties.property: EDGE-BP-NEXT-TX returns to iteration when more transactions remain. Iterator advances to next transaction.
properties.anti_property: Loop terminates prematurely or skips transactions.
properties.reachability_rationale: Iterator correctly tracks position in transaction list.
properties.notes: Condition: more transactions in block.

properties.property: EDGE-BP-ALL-DONE correctly exits iteration when all transactions are processed.
properties.anti_property: Loop exits before all transactions processed.
properties.reachability_rationale: Condition: no more transactions in block. All have been executed and receipts collected.
properties.notes: Transition to post-transaction phase.

properties.property: EDGE-BP-REQUESTS triggers Prague system calls after all user transactions complete.
properties.anti_property: System calls executed before user transactions complete.
properties.reachability_rationale: Ordering ensures user transactions see consistent state before system calls modify it.
properties.notes: Prague+ only. EIP-6110/7002/7251 system calls.

properties.property: EDGE-BP-FINALIZE triggers block finalization after all system calls complete.
properties.anti_property: Finalization occurs before system calls, missing their state changes.
properties.reachability_rationale: System calls precede finalization to ensure their state changes are included.
properties.notes: Final state mutations before root computation.

properties.property: EDGE-BP-COMPLETE returns DATA-PROCESS-RESULT with complete receipts, requests, and gas accounting.
properties.anti_property: Incomplete or incorrect process result returned.
properties.reachability_rationale: Result aggregates all receipts, logs, and gas from processing.
properties.notes: Return point to main graph for state root verification.

properties.property: STATE-ST-START is the entry point for individual transaction execution. Transaction has been converted to Message format.
properties.anti_property: State transition begins with unconverted transaction data.
properties.reachability_rationale: Entry from block processing sub-graph via ACTION-APPLY-TX-WITH-EVM.
properties.notes: Sub-graph entry point for state_transition.go

properties.property: ACTION-ST-VERIFY-SIGNATURE performs secp256k1 signature verification. Invalid signatures prevent further processing.
properties.anti_property: Transactions with invalid signatures proceed to execution.
properties.reachability_rationale: Signature verification is mandatory first step. For block transactions, signatures were pre-verified during pool acceptance.
properties.notes: Sender address derived from signature recovery.

properties.property: ACTION-ST-CHECK-NONCE verifies transaction nonce matches sender's account nonce. Prevents replay and ensures ordering.
properties.anti_property: Transactions with incorrect nonces are executed.
properties.reachability_rationale: Nonce check has two outcomes: match proceeds, mismatch fails. No bypass exists.
properties.notes: Nonce prevents replay attacks and enforces transaction ordering.

properties.property: ACTION-ST-COMPUTE-INTRINSIC-GAS correctly calculates base transaction cost including data costs and access list.
properties.anti_property: Incorrect intrinsic gas allows underpriced transactions.
properties.reachability_rationale: IntrinsicGas calculation is deterministic based on transaction data and type.
properties.notes: Base cost 21000 + data costs + access list costs + creation cost if applicable.

properties.property: ACTION-ST-CHECK-GAS-LIMIT verifies transaction gas limit >= intrinsic gas. Insufficient gas limit fails the transaction.
properties.anti_property: Transactions with insufficient gas limit proceed to execution.
properties.reachability_rationale: Gas limit check has two outcomes: sufficient proceeds, insufficient fails.
properties.notes: Prevents impossible-to-execute transactions.

properties.property: ACTION-ST-CHECK-BALANCE verifies sender has sufficient balance for gas and value. Balance >= gas * gasPrice + value + blobGas.
properties.anti_property: Transactions from accounts with insufficient balance are executed.
properties.reachability_rationale: Balance check has two outcomes: sufficient proceeds to deduction, insufficient fails.
properties.notes: Prevents negative balance creation.

properties.property: ACTION-ST-DEDUCT-GAS atomically deducts maximum gas cost from sender balance. Pre-payment prevents mid-execution balance issues.
properties.anti_property: Gas not properly deducted, allowing free execution.
properties.reachability_rationale: Gas deduction is atomic state change. Amount = gasLimit * effectiveGasPrice.
properties.notes: Unused gas refunded after execution.

properties.property: ACTION-ST-INCREMENT-NONCE increments sender nonce before execution. Prevents same-nonce replay within transaction.
properties.anti_property: Nonce not incremented, allowing same-nonce reuse.
properties.reachability_rationale: Nonce increment is atomic and irreversible even on execution revert.
properties.notes: Nonce increment is permanent regardless of execution outcome.

properties.property: ACTION-ST-PROCESS-ACCESS-LIST (EIP-2930) warms specified addresses and storage slots. Reduces gas cost for pre-declared accesses.
properties.anti_property: Access list not processed, causing incorrect gas charges.
properties.reachability_rationale: Access list processing is deterministic. Empty list is a no-op.
properties.notes: EIP-2930 introduced optional access lists.

properties.property: ACTION-ST-PROCESS-SETCODE-AUTHS (EIP-7702) applies code delegation authorizations. Only valid, properly signed authorizations are processed.
properties.anti_property: Invalid or forged authorizations are accepted.
properties.reachability_rationale: Each authorization is independently verified for signature, chain ID, and nonce.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: secp256k1 signature verification for each authorization
properties.notes: Prague+ (EIP-7702). Enables EOA code delegation.

properties.property: STATE-ST-PRE-EXECUTION indicates all pre-execution checks passed. Gas deducted, nonce incremented, access list processed.
properties.anti_property: Execution begins without completing pre-execution setup.
properties.reachability_rationale: Only reachable after all validation and setup steps complete successfully.
properties.notes: Branch point: creation (To==nil) or call (To!=nil).

properties.property: ACTION-ST-EXECUTE-CREATE deploys new contract via evm.Create(). Initcode is executed in EVM sandbox with proper gas limits.
properties.anti_property: Malicious initcode escapes EVM sandbox or bypasses gas limits.
properties.reachability_rationale: EVM sandbox contains execution. Gas limits and EIP-3860 initcode limits bound resource consumption.
properties.notes: Delegates to GRAPH-EVM-EXECUTION. Contract address computed deterministically.

properties.property: ACTION-ST-EXECUTE-CALL invokes contract via evm.Call(). Bytecode executed in EVM sandbox with proper isolation.
properties.anti_property: Malicious bytecode escapes EVM sandbox or corrupts system state.
properties.reachability_rationale: EVM sandbox provides execution isolation. Gas metering prevents resource exhaustion.
properties.notes: Delegates to GRAPH-EVM-EXECUTION. Reentrancy controlled by gas and call depth.

properties.property: STATE-ST-EXECUTION-COMPLETE indicates EVM execution finished. DATA-EXECUTION-RESULT contains gas used and any error.
properties.anti_property: Execution result doesn't accurately reflect EVM outcome.
properties.reachability_rationale: Reached via completion edges from EVM execution. Result accurately captures outcome.
properties.notes: Execution success/failure determines receipt status.

properties.property: ACTION-ST-CALCULATE-REFUND computes gas refund capped at 20% (EIP-3529). SSTORE refunds are limited to prevent exploitation.
properties.anti_property: Excessive refunds allow gas-free state manipulation.
properties.reachability_rationale: Refund calculation is deterministic. Cap prevents refund exploitation attacks.
properties.notes: EIP-3529 reduced max refund from 50% to 20% of gas used.

properties.property: ACTION-ST-REFUND-SENDER returns unused gas and refund to sender. Balance correctly increased by unused portion.
properties.anti_property: Refund calculation error causes over/under-refunding.
properties.reachability_rationale: Refund = (gasLimit - gasUsed + min(refund, gasUsed/5)) * effectiveGasPrice
properties.notes: Sender receives back unused gas value.

properties.property: ACTION-ST-PAY-COINBASE pays priority fee to block producer. Base fee is burned (not paid). EIP-1559 fee split correctly applied.
properties.anti_property: Coinbase receives base fee (should be burned) or incorrect priority fee.
properties.reachability_rationale: Coinbase payment = gasUsed * (effectiveGasPrice - baseFee). Base fee implicitly burned.
properties.notes: EIP-1559: base fee burned, only priority fee to coinbase.

properties.property: ACTION-ST-CREATE-RECEIPT generates accurate receipt with status, gas used, and logs. Receipt commitment included in block header.
properties.anti_property: Receipt contains incorrect status, gas, or logs.
properties.reachability_rationale: Receipt is deterministically generated from execution result.
properties.notes: MakeReceipt creates receipt from execution result.

properties.property: STATE-ST-COMPLETE indicates successful state transition. Transaction fully processed with receipt generated.
properties.anti_property: State transition marked complete without full processing.
properties.reachability_rationale: Only reached via successful completion path through all processing steps.
properties.notes: Return point to block processing sub-graph.

properties.property: STATE-ST-FAILED correctly handles pre-execution validation failures. Nonce mismatch, gas limit, or balance failures route here.
properties.anti_property: Validation failures don't terminate processing.
properties.reachability_rationale: Terminal state for pre-execution failures. Each failure edge leads definitively here.
properties.notes: Pre-execution failures prevent any state changes.

properties.property: STATE-EVM-START is the entry point to EVM execution. Contract code and initial gas are set.
properties.anti_property: EVM execution begins without proper initialization.
properties.reachability_rationale: Entry from state transition via ACTION-ST-EXECUTE-CREATE or ACTION-ST-EXECUTE-CALL.
properties.notes: Source file: core/vm/interpreter.go

properties.property: ACTION-EVM-CHECK-DEPTH enforces call depth limit of 1024. Prevents stack overflow attacks and unbounded recursion.
properties.anti_property: Call depth can exceed 1024, causing stack overflow.
properties.reachability_rationale: Depth check is mandatory. Excess depth causes immediate failure with ErrDepth.
properties.notes: Maximum call depth: 1024. Prevents call stack attacks.

properties.property: ACTION-EVM-CREATE-CONTRACT initializes contract execution context. Caller, value, and gas are correctly set.
properties.anti_property: Contract context incorrectly initialized, causing wrong execution.
properties.reachability_rationale: NewContract is deterministic. Context inherits from caller correctly.
properties.notes: Contract has reference to caller, value, gas, and code.

properties.property: STATE-EVM-INTERPRETER-LOOP is the main execution loop. Each iteration processes one opcode with proper gas metering.
properties.anti_property: Opcodes processed without gas metering or stack checks.
properties.reachability_rationale: Loop processes opcodes sequentially. Each opcode goes through: fetch -> lookup -> stack check -> gas -> memory -> execute.
properties.notes: DATA-SCOPE-CONTEXT contains Memory, Stack, and Contract.

properties.property: ACTION-EVM-FETCH-OPCODE reads opcode at current program counter. End of code detected correctly.
properties.anti_property: Out-of-bounds read from bytecode.
properties.reachability_rationale: PC bounds are checked. Reading past code end returns STOP (0x00).
properties.notes: PC incremented after fetch for most opcodes.

properties.property: ACTION-EVM-LOOKUP-OPERATION retrieves operation from fork-specific jump table. Undefined opcodes are detected.
properties.anti_property: Undefined opcodes execute arbitrary code.
properties.reachability_rationale: Jump table has 256 entries. Undefined opcodes have nil handler leading to invalid opcode error.
properties.notes: Jump table selected based on active hard fork.

properties.property: ACTION-EVM-CHECK-STACK verifies stack has required inputs and room for outputs. Stack bounds enforced.
properties.anti_property: Stack underflow/overflow not detected.
properties.reachability_rationale: Stack check is mandatory. Violations route to error state.
properties.notes: Max stack size: 1024. Each op has minStack/maxStack.

properties.property: ACTION-EVM-CALCULATE-GAS computes constant + dynamic gas for operation. All gas costs correctly calculated.
properties.anti_property: Gas undercharged, allowing DoS via cheap expensive operations.
properties.reachability_rationale: Gas calculation is deterministic based on operation and arguments.
properties.notes: Dynamic gas for memory expansion, storage operations, etc.

properties.property: ACTION-EVM-DEDUCT-GAS deducts gas before execution. Insufficient gas detected before operation runs.
properties.anti_property: Operation executes before gas deduction, causing free execution.
properties.reachability_rationale: UseGas is called before execute. Failure routes to out-of-gas error.
properties.notes: Gas metering is pre-execution, not post.

properties.property: ACTION-EVM-EXPAND-MEMORY grows memory as needed with proper gas charging. Memory expansion cost is quadratic.
properties.anti_property: Memory expansion bypasses gas charging.
properties.reachability_rationale: Memory expansion gas is included in dynamic gas calculation and deducted.
properties.notes: Memory cost: 3 * words + words^2 / 512

properties.property: ACTION-EVM-EXECUTE-OPCODE runs opcode handler after all checks pass. Execution is sandboxed by EVM.
properties.anti_property: Opcode handler can escape EVM sandbox.
properties.reachability_rationale: Opcode handlers are carefully implemented. State changes go through StateDB interface.
properties.notes: operation.execute(pc, evm, scope)

properties.property: ACTION-EVM-INCREMENT-PC advances program counter for next iteration. JUMP/JUMPI set PC directly.
properties.anti_property: PC manipulation allows jumping to arbitrary code.
properties.reachability_rationale: PC is incremented by instruction size. JUMP validates destination is JUMPDEST.
properties.notes: JUMPDEST analysis prevents jumping into data.

properties.property: STATE-EVM-EXECUTION-SUCCESS indicates normal completion via STOP, RETURN, or code end. All state changes persisted.
properties.anti_property: Success reported for failed executions.
properties.reachability_rationale: Only reached via STOP or RETURN opcode execution, or reaching end of code.
properties.notes: RETURN provides return data. STOP returns empty.

properties.property: STATE-EVM-EXECUTION-REVERT indicates REVERT opcode executed. All state changes in this call frame are rolled back.
properties.anti_property: REVERT doesn't roll back state changes.
properties.reachability_rationale: REVERT triggers snapshot revert. State rolled back to call entry point.
properties.notes: Gas consumed is not refunded. Return data available to caller.

properties.property: STATE-EVM-EXECUTION-ERROR handles all execution failures. State changes rolled back, remaining gas consumed.
properties.anti_property: Errors don't properly clean up execution state.
properties.reachability_rationale: Terminal error state. Multiple error paths converge here.
properties.notes: All remaining gas consumed on error (unlike REVERT).

properties.property: STATE-EVM-OUT-OF-GAS correctly handles gas exhaustion. Execution terminates, state reverted.
properties.anti_property: Execution continues without gas.
properties.reachability_rationale: Gas exhaustion is detected during UseGas call. Immediate termination.
properties.notes: ErrOutOfGas terminates execution.

properties.property: STATE-EVM-STACK-OVERFLOW handles stack violations. Stack underflow and overflow both terminate execution.
properties.anti_property: Stack violations don't terminate execution.
properties.reachability_rationale: Stack check before each operation catches violations.
properties.notes: ErrStackOverflow or ErrStackUnderflow.

properties.property: STATE-EVM-INVALID-OPCODE handles undefined opcodes. Unknown opcodes terminate execution with error.
properties.anti_property: Undefined opcodes have exploitable behavior.
properties.reachability_rationale: Jump table lookup for undefined opcode returns nil, triggering error.
properties.notes: ErrInvalidOpCode terminates execution.

properties.property: STATE-PUSH0-OPCODE-START represents the entry point for EIP-3855 PUSH0 opcode. Execution only proceeds after standard opcode dispatch.
properties.anti_property: PUSH0 opcode can be invoked outside normal EVM dispatch.
properties.reachability_rationale: PUSH0 is dispatched through the EVM jump table. Shanghai+ fork activation is required.
properties.notes: EIP-3855: PUSH0 opcode (0x5f) pushes constant zero to stack.

properties.property: ACTION-PUSH0-CHARGE-GAS correctly charges 2 gas (GasQuickStep) before pushing zero. Gas exhaustion terminates execution.
properties.anti_property: PUSH0 executes without proper gas accounting.
properties.reachability_rationale: Gas is charged before stack modification. Out-of-gas causes execution failure.
properties.notes: Gas cost: 2 (GasQuickStep)

properties.property: ACTION-PUSH0-PUSH-VALUE pushes exactly zero onto the stack. Stack overflow check ensures stack depth limit is not exceeded.
properties.anti_property: PUSH0 pushes non-zero value or bypasses stack limit.
properties.reachability_rationale: Stack push is bounded by 1024 depth limit. Value is hardcoded zero.
properties.notes: scope.Stack.push(uint256.Int{})

properties.property: STATE-PUSH0-COMPLETE indicates successful PUSH0 execution. PC increments by 1 for next instruction.
properties.anti_property: PUSH0 completion leaves EVM in inconsistent state.
properties.reachability_rationale: Normal completion path. EVM continues execution loop.
properties.notes: PUSH0 is a single-byte opcode.

properties.property: EDGE-PUSH0-GAS represents mandatory gas charging before execution. Transition only occurs if gas is available.
properties.anti_property: Gas charging can be bypassed on PUSH0.
properties.reachability_rationale: Gas charging is first step in opcode execution.
properties.notes: Gas-first execution model.

properties.property: EDGE-PUSH0-PUSH represents transition from gas charging to value push. Only reached after successful gas deduction.
properties.anti_property: Value push occurs without gas deduction.
properties.reachability_rationale: Sequential execution enforced by EVM interpreter.
properties.notes: Gas already charged before reaching this edge.

properties.property: EDGE-PUSH0-DONE represents successful completion of PUSH0 opcode. EVM returns to main execution loop.
properties.anti_property: PUSH0 completion edge leads to incorrect state.
properties.reachability_rationale: Completion edge only traversed on success.
properties.notes: Normal termination path.

properties.property: STATE-SELFDESTRUCT-START represents SELFDESTRUCT opcode entry. Post-Cancun, destruction only occurs if contract was created in same transaction.
properties.anti_property: SELFDESTRUCT destroys contracts created in prior transactions post-Cancun.
properties.reachability_rationale: EIP-6780 restricts SELFDESTRUCT to same-transaction creation only.
properties.notes: EIP-6780: SELFDESTRUCT behavior change (Cancun+).

properties.property: ACTION-SD-CHECK-SAME-TX verifies if contract was created in current transaction. This determines whether balance transfer only or full destruction occurs.
properties.anti_property: Same-transaction check can be bypassed or manipulated.
properties.reachability_rationale: Check is based on StateDB.Created flag set during CREATE.
properties.notes: StateDB tracks creation within transaction.

properties.property: ACTION-SD-TRANSFER-BALANCE transfers contract balance to beneficiary. Transfer occurs regardless of same-transaction status.
properties.anti_property: Balance transfer can fail or send to wrong beneficiary.
properties.reachability_rationale: Balance transfer uses StateDB.SubBalance and AddBalance atomically.
properties.notes: Beneficiary address from stack top.

properties.property: ACTION-SD-MARK-DESTRUCTED marks contract for destruction (same-tx only). Code and storage cleared at transaction finalization.
properties.anti_property: Destruction marking occurs for non-same-tx contracts.
properties.reachability_rationale: Only reached when same-tx check passes. StateDB.Destruct called.
properties.notes: StateDB.selfDestructed set tracks destruction.

properties.property: STATE-SD-BALANCE-ONLY represents post-Cancun behavior where only balance is transferred. Contract code and storage remain intact.
properties.anti_property: Balance-only path causes contract destruction.
properties.reachability_rationale: Path taken when same-tx check fails. No StateDB.Destruct call.
properties.notes: Contract remains callable after SELFDESTRUCT.

properties.property: STATE-SD-FULL-DESTRUCT represents complete contract destruction when created same-tx. Code cleared, storage deleted, balance transferred.
properties.anti_property: Full destruction path leaves contract state intact.
properties.reachability_rationale: Only reached via same-tx path. Full cleanup at finalization.
properties.notes: StateDB.clearDestructed processes marked accounts.

properties.property: STATE-SD-COMPLETE marks SELFDESTRUCT opcode completion. Execution terminates for current call frame.
properties.anti_property: Execution continues after SELFDESTRUCT.
properties.reachability_rationale: SELFDESTRUCT is a terminating opcode. Returns from call frame.
properties.notes: Similar to STOP, terminates execution.

properties.property: All edges in GRAPH-EIP-6780-SELFDESTRUCT enforce the EIP-6780 same-transaction check. Path selection is deterministic based on creation status.
properties.anti_property: Edge selection can be manipulated to bypass same-tx check.
properties.reachability_rationale: Edge transitions are controlled by EVM interpreter logic.
properties.notes: 7 edges in SELFDESTRUCT graph.

properties.property: STATE-BLOBHASH-OPCODE-START represents BLOBHASH (0x49) opcode entry. Returns versioned hash of blob at given index from current transaction.
properties.anti_property: BLOBHASH returns hashes from other transactions.
properties.reachability_rationale: BLOBHASH only accesses current tx's blob hashes via EVM context.
properties.notes: EIP-4844: Proto-danksharding (Cancun+).

properties.property: All nodes in GRAPH-EIP-4844-BLOBHASH implement secure blob hash retrieval. Index bounds checking prevents out-of-bounds access.
properties.anti_property: Blob hash retrieval can access out-of-bounds indices or wrong transaction data.
properties.reachability_rationale: Bounds check returns zero for invalid indices. No panic or error.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: Blob hashes are KZG commitment hashes
properties.notes: 7 nodes, 7 edges in BLOBHASH graph.

properties.property: All edges in GRAPH-EIP-4844-BLOBHASH enforce proper gas charging and bounds checking. Out-of-bounds returns zero, not error.
properties.anti_property: Edge transitions bypass gas charging or bounds checking.
properties.reachability_rationale: All paths through graph enforce required checks.
properties.notes: Gas cost: 3 (GasVeryLow).

properties.property: All nodes in GRAPH-EIP-1153-TRANSIENT-STORAGE implement transaction-scoped storage. TSTORE/TLOAD data is cleared after transaction completion.
properties.anti_property: Transient storage persists across transaction boundaries.
properties.reachability_rationale: Transient storage is stored in StateDB.transientStorage map, cleared per-tx.
properties.notes: EIP-1153: Transient storage opcodes (Cancun+). 12 nodes.

properties.property: All edges in GRAPH-EIP-1153-TRANSIENT-STORAGE enforce proper gas charging (100 gas) and transaction-scoped semantics.
properties.anti_property: Transient storage operations bypass gas charging or cross transaction boundaries.
properties.reachability_rationale: EVM interpreter enforces sequential execution and gas charging.
properties.notes: Gas cost: 100 (WarmStorageReadCost). 12 edges.

properties.property: All nodes in GRAPH-EIP-5656-MCOPY implement safe memory-to-memory copy. Overlapping regions handled correctly via intermediate buffer.
properties.anti_property: MCOPY corrupts memory on overlapping copy operations.
properties.reachability_rationale: Go's copy() handles overlap correctly. Memory expansion charged before copy.
properties.notes: EIP-5656: MCOPY opcode (Cancun+). 6 nodes.

properties.property: All edges in GRAPH-EIP-5656-MCOPY enforce proper gas calculation including memory expansion costs before copy execution.
properties.anti_property: Memory copy occurs before gas charging or memory expansion.
properties.reachability_rationale: Gas = 3 + 3*ceil(length/32) + memory expansion cost.
properties.notes: 5 edges in MCOPY graph.

properties.property: All nodes in GRAPH-EIP-1559-FEE-MARKET implement correct base fee calculation. Fee adjusts by max 12.5% per block based on gas usage vs target.
properties.anti_property: Base fee calculation allows >12.5% change or incorrect directional adjustment.
properties.reachability_rationale: Formula: baseFee += (parentBaseFee * delta) / (target * 8). Max 12.5% change.
properties.notes: EIP-1559: Fee market change (London+). 10 nodes.

properties.property: All edges in GRAPH-EIP-1559-FEE-MARKET enforce correct fee flow. Base fee is burned, only priority fee goes to coinbase.
properties.anti_property: Base fee is paid to coinbase instead of being burned.
properties.reachability_rationale: Fee burning is hardcoded in state transition logic.
properties.notes: 12 edges in EIP-1559 graph. Missing 12th edge from spec would be completion.

properties.property: All nodes in GRAPH-EIP-7702-SETCODE implement secure EOA code delegation. Signature verification, chain ID check, and nonce validation are mandatory.
properties.anti_property: Code delegation occurs without proper authorization signature or nonce verification.
properties.reachability_rationale: All authorization checks must pass before delegation is set. Signature recovery uses secp256k1.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: secp256k1 signature verification for each authorization
properties.notes: EIP-7702: Set EOA account code (Prague+). 7 nodes.

properties.property: All edges in GRAPH-EIP-7702-SETCODE enforce sequential authorization verification. Each authorization is independently validated.
properties.anti_property: Authorization verification can be skipped or reordered.
properties.reachability_rationale: Iteration processes each authorization sequentially with all checks.
properties.notes: 7 edges in EIP-7702 graph.

properties.property: All nodes in GRAPH-EIP-3860-INITCODE enforce initcode size limit (49152 bytes) and gas metering. Oversized initcode causes immediate rejection.
properties.anti_property: Initcode larger than 49152 bytes is accepted or gas is not charged.
properties.reachability_rationale: Size check is first step. MAX_INITCODE_SIZE = 49152 enforced.
properties.notes: EIP-3860: Limit and meter initcode (Shanghai+). 7 nodes.

properties.property: All edges in GRAPH-EIP-3860-INITCODE enforce size check before gas charging. Gas cost = 2 * ceil(len/32).
properties.anti_property: Initcode gas is charged before size validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: Size check precedes gas calculation. INITCODE_WORD_COST = 2.
properties.notes: 6 edges in EIP-3860 graph.

properties.property: All nodes in GRAPH-EIP-4895-WITHDRAWALS implement unconditional withdrawal processing. Balance credits MUST NOT fail and consume no gas.
properties.anti_property: Withdrawal processing can fail or consumes gas.
properties.reachability_rationale: Withdrawals are system-level operations. AddBalance cannot fail. No gas consumed.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: Withdrawals root verified against header commitment
properties.notes: EIP-4895: Beacon chain withdrawals (Shanghai+). 7 nodes.

properties.property: All edges in GRAPH-EIP-4895-WITHDRAWALS enforce withdrawal root validation before processing. Invalid root rejects entire block.
properties.anti_property: Withdrawals processed before root validation or with mismatched root.
properties.reachability_rationale: Root validation is mandatory first step. Trie root matches header.
properties.notes: 7 edges in EIP-4895 graph.

properties.property: All nodes in GRAPH-EIP-7516-BLOBBASEFEE implement BLOBBASEFEE opcode. Returns current block's blob base fee from EVM context.
properties.anti_property: BLOBBASEFEE returns incorrect value or value from wrong block.
properties.reachability_rationale: Value read from evm.Context.BlobBaseFee set at block start.
properties.notes: EIP-7516: BLOBBASEFEE opcode (Cancun+). 5 nodes.

properties.property: All edges in GRAPH-EIP-7516-BLOBBASEFEE enforce 2 gas charge before value access. Stack push follows gas deduction.
properties.anti_property: Blob base fee accessed without gas charge.
properties.reachability_rationale: Gas-first execution model. GasQuickStep = 2.
properties.notes: 4 edges in EIP-7516 graph.

properties.property: All nodes in GRAPH-EIP-4788-BEACON-ROOT implement beacon root storage and retrieval. Ring buffer (8191 slots) stores parent beacon block roots for cross-layer verification.
properties.anti_property: Beacon roots stored incorrectly or retrievable for wrong timestamps.
properties.reachability_rationale: Ring buffer index = timestamp % 8191. Timestamp verification prevents stale access.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: Beacon block root is cryptographic commitment from CL
properties.notes: EIP-4788: Beacon block root in EVM (Cancun+). 11 nodes.

properties.property: All edges in GRAPH-EIP-4788-BEACON-ROOT enforce system call execution at block start and timestamp verification on query.
properties.anti_property: Beacon root storage bypassed or queries return unverified roots.
properties.reachability_rationale: System call is mandatory at block start. Query validates timestamp match.
properties.notes: 11 edges in EIP-4788 graph. Note: EDGE count is 11 not 9 in spec.

properties.reachability_rationale: Log filtering uses exact address and topic match. Order preserved from receipt.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: Deposit log signature verified via topic hash
properties.notes: EIP-6110: Validator deposits on chain (Prague+). 7 nodes.

properties.anti_property: Malformed deposit logs accepted into requests.
properties.reachability_rationale: Format validation checks 192-byte payload structure.
properties.notes: 7 edges in EIP-6110 graph.

properties.reachability_rationale: Fee check enforced before enqueue. Max 16 requests dequeued per block.
properties.notes: EIP-7002: EL triggerable exits (Prague+). 13 nodes.

properties.property: All edges in GRAPH-EIP-7002-WITHDRAWALS enforce input validation, fee checking, and system call execution order.

properties.notes: EIP-7251: MAX_EFFECTIVE_BALANCE increase (Prague+). 13 nodes.

properties.notes: 12 edges in EIP-7251 graph. Note: 11 listed, spec has 12.

properties.property: All nodes in GRAPH-EIP-2935-BLOCKHASH-STATE implement parent block hash storage in system contract. Ring buffer (8191 slots) enables extended BLOCKHASH range.
properties.anti_property: Block hashes stored incorrectly or wrong hash returned for block number.
properties.reachability_rationale: Ring buffer slot = (block.number - 1) % 8191. System call at block start.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: Block hash is cryptographic commitment to block header
properties.notes: EIP-2935: Historical block hashes in state (Prague+). 7 nodes but spec shows 8.

properties.property: All edges in GRAPH-EIP-2935-BLOCKHASH-STATE enforce system call execution before transactions and proper ring buffer indexing.
properties.anti_property: Block hash storage occurs after transactions or uses incorrect index.
properties.reachability_rationale: System call is mandatory pre-transaction operation.
properties.notes: 6 edges in EIP-2935 graph.

properties.property: All nodes in GRAPH-EIP-7939-CLZ implement CLZ (Count Leading Zeros) opcode. Result is 256 - BitLen(x) for 256-bit value.
properties.anti_property: CLZ returns incorrect count or causes stack corruption.
properties.reachability_rationale: In-place modification of stack top. Result = 256 - x.BitLen().
properties.notes: EIP-7939: CLZ opcode (Osaka+). 6 nodes.

properties.property: All edges in GRAPH-EIP-7939-CLZ enforce 5 gas charge (GasFastStep) before computation. Stack peek-modify pattern used.

properties.reachability_rationale: Gas-first execution. GasFastStep = 5.

properties.reachability_rationale: Access lists tracked in StateDB. Cold/warm checked per access.
properties.notes: EIP-2929: Gas cost increases (Berlin+). 17 nodes. Note: 15 listed, spec has 17.

properties.anti_property: Gas charged before cold/warm determination or access not tracked.
properties.reachability_rationale: Check precedes charge. Cold access marked warm after first access.
properties.notes: 16 edges in EIP-2929 graph. Note: 14 listed, spec has 16.
