properties.property: EDGE-USER-SUBMIT-TX is the primary trust boundary. All external user input is untrusted and subject to comprehensive validation before any processing.
properties.anti_property: User-submitted data bypasses validation or is partially validated.
properties.reachability_rationale: The edge leads directly to ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-TX which performs comprehensive validation. No bypass path exists in the graph.
properties.notes: CRITICAL BOUNDARY EDGE: This is the primary attack surface. Validation includes: signature verification, nonce check, balance verification, gas limit check, transaction format validation, EIP-specific constraints.

properties.property: P2P transaction reception from SEMI_TRUSTED peers requires same validation as user-submitted transactions. DoS protections (rate limiting, fee requirements) are applied.
properties.anti_property: Transactions from P2P peers bypass validation or DoS protections.
properties.reachability_rationale: P2P received transactions flow through the same validation path as user-submitted transactions. The transaction pool validates all incoming transactions regardless of source.
properties.notes: HIGH RISK BOUNDARY: Peers may forward invalid transactions intentionally or due to bugs. Full validation required.

properties.property: Blocks from P2P peers are UNTRUSTED until fully validated. Complete validation includes header validation, transaction root verification, full transaction execution, and state root verification.
properties.anti_property: P2P blocks are accepted without full validation, enabling consensus attacks.
properties.reachability_rationale: Blocks from P2P sync undergo the same validation as blocks from newPayload. The block validation pipeline is mandatory for all block sources.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: Full cryptographic validation: header hash, transaction root, state root, receipts root
properties.notes: CRITICAL BOUNDARY: Attack surface for consensus-breaking attacks. Invalid blocks must be rejected and peers may be penalized.

properties.property: Even though CL is TRUSTED, execution payloads may originate from malicious validators on the beacon chain. Full payload validation is mandatory regardless of trusted source.
properties.anti_property: Payloads from trusted CL are accepted without validation due to trust relationship.
properties.reachability_rationale: The graph enforces: JWT validation -> structural validation -> block processing -> state root verification. Trust in CL doesn't bypass any validation step.
properties.notes: MEDIUM RISK BOUNDARY: Trust in CL doesn't extend to payload content. Defense in depth requires full validation.

properties.property: Contract creation sends untrusted initcode to EVM for execution. The EVM sandbox MUST safely execute arbitrary initcode without compromising the system.
properties.anti_property: Malicious initcode can escape EVM sandbox or cause unbounded resource consumption.
properties.reachability_rationale: EVM sandbox provides: gas limits, call depth limits, EIP-3860 initcode size limits, memory expansion costs. All bound resource consumption.
properties.notes: MEDIUM RISK BOUNDARY: Initcode is untrusted user data. EVM sandbox is the security perimeter.

properties.property: Contract calls send untrusted calldata to EVM for execution. The EVM MUST safely execute arbitrary bytecode with arbitrary input without system compromise.
properties.anti_property: Malicious calldata or bytecode escapes EVM sandbox.
properties.reachability_rationale: EVM provides sandboxing through: gas metering, stack/memory limits, state isolation, call depth limits. Reentrancy bounded by gas.
properties.notes: MEDIUM RISK BOUNDARY: Calldata flows from untrusted source into EVM. Contract bytecode may be malicious.

properties.property: State commitment only occurs for fully validated blocks. The Merkle Patricia Trie provides cryptographic integrity guarantees for committed state.
properties.anti_property: Invalid or partially validated state is committed to persistent storage.
properties.reachability_rationale: EDGE-VALID-COMMIT only originates from STATE-EL-BLOCK-VALID, which requires complete block validation including state root match.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: Merkle Patricia Trie provides tamper-evident state commitment
properties.notes: BOUNDARY: Transition from in-memory state to persistent storage. Atomic commit ensures consistency.
